groups.label: U-Bahn

groups.label: S-Bahn
groups.source: chosen: the green of the S-Bahn sign, approximate; vbb.zip gives most S lines their own route_color. Pinned at dL +0.10 (trail #8ee8ae). At -0.12 (#46a16b) it was 0.045 from the Regional coral under protanopia, and the two run side by side for 237 km (the Stadtbahn and the radial lines); now 0.307 (0.212 deutan, 0.306 protan)

groups.label: Regional
groups.source: chosen: DB red EC0016 for the regional trains (DB Regio, ODEG, NEB), approximate. Pinned at dL -0.12 (trail #cb6d63) so it reads DB red, not coral (#f49287 at the source step), and sits darker than the S-Bahn for both kinds of red-green colour blindness
